gen-dafont-starborn-poppins: Starborn drifts along with huge gaps between its letters and a dense dark band of lowercase, dreamy and weightless. Poppins underneath draws its curves like loose rope, with no thick-thin flicker.
gen-dafont-vcr-osd-mono-archivo: VCR OSD Mono has a towering x-height and fixed-width, code-style letters. Archivo follows with curves that open outward and a commanding lowercase, so paragraphs feel approachable and editorial rather than terminal-cold.
gen-dafont-vcr-osd-mono-fs-merriweather-: VCR OSD Mono does lo-fi, retro-tech best, its fixed-width letters holding one steady weight from word to word. And Merriweather Sans does sturdiness, with tall lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
gen-dafont-visitor-poppins: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor gapes at the e and tucks short ascenders above big bowls, like solder pulled through a nozzle. Poppins is its smooth, modern foil.
gen-dafont-woodgod-poppins: Vintage muscle, right up front. Woodgod's tall lowercase nearly touches its capitals, while Poppins runs below with modern, clean curves of uniform line width, so a long page moves along smoothly.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-bespoke-sans: DM Serif Text builds its letters from heavy stems and thread-thin arms, giving an editorial, bookish feel. Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, supplies the quiet counterweight.
gen-eater-bitter: Bitter brings a dependable, grounded slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and a see-through gap in each s, under Eater's dark, aggressive display letters. A long read stays steady and easy to follow.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta brings a professional, approachable sans with a big x-height and c shapes like a wide mouth. And Unica One adds commanding, distinctive letters with daylight visible inside every curve.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-exa: Gugi is the distinctive, bold one, with tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals and terminals cut open. And Lexend Exa does clean professionalism, its wide-open curves staying distinct beside a big x-height.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-tera: Revalia's open-curved g and relaxed, widely spaced stride stand out at once. Lexend Tera answers with a plotter-pen line and letters spaced like stepping stones, giving the pair a ruled, drawn-with-compass steadiness against Revalia's looseness.
